component: SMTP client error callback and server connection pool

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The socket-error handler now awaits its installed error callback before calling _free(true). The server callback awaits the terminal listener, while onFree returns the client to the pool and wakes a queued sender. The regression waits for two refused-connection listener results after a successful baseline with one cached client. This is source ordering and direct test-code coverage; callback rejection is not caught here and no live queue or universal cleanup result was established.
title: SMTP socket errors await the active send listener before releasing the client
